blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video generation models are increasingly viewed as world simulators, which requires not only plausible motion but dynamics that respond correctly to specified physical parameters. Existing models, datasets and benchmarks, however, largely target physical plausibility, leaving this physical parameter responsiveness insufficiently explored. We introduce PhysResponse, a benchmark that measures it at two levels: scene-conditioned simulator inversion recovers the effective gravity, friction and initial speed of generated motion, and event evaluation tests outcomes near and across critical transitions. Evaluating ten image-to-video models, we find that even the lowest parameter errors exceed those of physically correct videos by over an order of magnitude, that models rarely reproduce both outcomes of a transition pair, and that the two levels expose complementary failures that visual metrics such as PSNR miss. To supply the missing training signal, we construct 72,000 simulated videos of 20 multi-object interaction types with controlled parameters; fine-tuning on them lowers parameter errors, even on held-out interaction types, and transfers to real videos and an external physics benchmark. Continued training with a numerical encoder further lowers all three errors on held-out types. PhysResponse provides a foundation for world simulators that follow physical conditions, not just appearances.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型日益被视为世界模拟器,它不仅需要可信的运动,而且需要动态能对指定的物理参数作出正确的反应。 然而,现有模型、数据集和基准主要针对物理可信性,使这一物理参数的响应性没有得到充分的探讨。 我们引入了物理反应(PhysResponse),这个基准在两个层面进行测量:场景条件模拟反演恢复生成运动的有效引力,摩擦和初始速度,以及事件评价测试结果接近和跨越关键过渡. 评估10个图像到视频模型,我们发现即使是最小的参数错误也比物理上正确的视频错误超过一个数量级以上,模型很少复制两个过渡对的结果,两个级别暴露出PSNR等视觉度量错失的互补失败. 为了提供缺失的训练信号,我们构建了72,000个模拟视频,包含20个多对象交互类型,具有可控参数;对它们进行微调,降低参数误差,即使是被搁置的交互类型,并传输到真实的视频和一个外部物理基准. 用数字编码器继续培训,进一步降低了所有三个被搁置类型的错误。 PhysResponse为遵循物理条件,而不仅仅是外观的世界模拟器提供了基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Rapid advances in video generation [ 55 , 39 , 38 , 29 ] have enabled unprecedented visual fidelity and realism, motivating a growing body of research to develop video generation models into world simulators [ 32 , 34 , 53 , 61 ] capable of understanding and predicting real-world physical dynamics. Alongside these advances, physics-focused datasets [ 31 , 25 ] and benchmarks have emerged to improve and evaluate models’ ability to generate physically plausible motion and interactions. Together, these efforts have established physical plausibility as an important criterion for assessing progress toward world simulation.
blocks.zh: 视频生成的迅速进步[55,39,38,29]使得视觉的忠实和现实性前所未有,激励了越来越多的研究,将视频生成模型发展成为能理解和预测现实世界物理动态的世界模拟器[32,34,53,61]. 除了这些进展之外,还出现了以物理学为重点的数据集[31、25]和基准,以提高和评价模型产生物理上可行的运动和相互作用的能力。 这些努力共同确立了物理可信性,作为评估世界模拟进展的重要标准。

blocks.en: However, physical plausibility alone is insufficient for a world simulator. Beyond producing realistic motion, a simulator must capture how dynamics change in response to specified physical parameters. In embodied AI, for example, it should predict how variations in gripper friction affect object manipulation. Such capabilities are essential for simulating interactions across scenarios and physical conditions. Yet existing models [ 53 , 11 ] , datasets [ 64 , 25 ] , and benchmarks [ 30 , 17 , 42 ] largely focus on a common question: Do the generated outcomes appear consistent with physical common sense? This leaves a more precise question insufficiently explored: Do the generated dynamics respond correctly to the specified physical parameters? We refer to this capability as physical parameter responsiveness. Addressing it requires evaluating not only whether a video depicts plausible dynamics, but also whether those dynamics are consistent with the particular parameter values provided.
blocks.zh: 然而,仅凭物理上的可信度不足以成为世界模拟器。 除了产生现实运动,模拟器必须捕捉动态变化如何响应指定的物理参数. 例如,在体现的AI中,它应该预测夹克摩擦的变化如何影响物体的操纵. 这种能力对于模拟各种情景和物理条件之间的相互作用至关重要。 然而,现有的模型[53、11]、数据集[64、25]和基准[30、17、42]主要侧重于一个共同的问题: 所产生的结果是否与物理常识相符? 这使一个更精确的问题没有得到充分探讨: 生成的动态是否正确响应指定的物理参数? 我们把这种能力称为物理参数响应。 解决该问题不仅需要评估视频是否描绘了可信的动态,而且需要评估这些动态是否与所提供的特定参数值一致。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we first introduce a benchmark and evaluation protocol for measuring physical parameter responsiveness at both the event and parameter levels. Using a physics simulator, we render multi-object interactions across 20 scenarios under varying combinations of gravitational acceleration, friction, and initial speed. Our event-level metrics assess whether generated videos exhibit the expected events under those conditions, while our parameter-level metrics measure how closely physical parameters recovered from the generated dynamics match their specified values. Together, these metrics evaluate both event outcomes and quantitative consistency with the conditioning parameters. Our evaluation shows that current models struggle to respond accurately to specified physical parameters (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们首先采用了衡量事件和参数两级物理参数响应性的基准和评价协议。 利用一个物理模拟器,我们在引力加速、摩擦和初始速度的不同组合下,在20个情景中产生多物体相互作用。 我们的事件层面的衡量标准评估生成的视频是否显示在这些条件下的预期事件,而我们的参数层面的衡量标准则衡量从生成的动态中恢复的物理参数如何与其规定的数值相匹配。 这些衡量标准加在一起,既评价事件结果,也评价与条件参数的定量一致性。 我们的评价表明,目前的模型难以准确响应指定的物理参数(图2)。

blocks.en: One factor that may contribute to this limitation is the lack of training data that systematically captures how physical parameters shape observable dynamics. We therefore develop a data generation pipeline with control over physical parameters and construct a dataset of 72,000 videos spanning 20 scenarios. The dataset depicts object motion and interactions under diverse parameter combinations, with particular emphasis on capturing variations that produce distinct motion patterns or event outcomes. This diversity provides training examples that connect parameter values to their observable physical effects. Experiments show that fine-tuning on our dataset improves physical parameter responsiveness, supporting the value of targeted data for learning dynamics.
blocks.zh: 造成这种限制的一个因素是缺乏系统掌握物理参数如何形成可观测动态的培训数据。 因此,我们开发了一个控制物理参数的数据生成管道,并构建了一个包含20个情景的72 000个视频的数据集。 数据集描绘了不同参数组合下的物体运动和相互作用,特别强调捕捉产生不同运动模式或事件结果的变化. 这种多样性提供了将参数值与其可观察到的物理效应联系起来的培训实例。 实验显示,我们数据集的微调可以提高物理参数的响应性,支持目标数据对学习动态的价值.

blocks.en: Beyond data, we investigate how model design can further improve physical parameter responsiveness. Specifically, we augment the baseline model with a numerical encoder and fine-tune the resulting model on our dataset. Continued training with the numerical encoder further improves parameter responsiveness, lowering all three errors on held-out interaction types, suggesting that strengthening numerical conditioning is a promising direction for enabling world simulators to accurately reproduce dynamics under specified physical conditions. Taken together, our benchmark, dataset, and model exploration provide a foundation for studying world simulation beyond general physical plausibility.
blocks.zh: 除了数据外,我们研究模型设计如何能够进一步提高物理参数的响应性. 具体来说,我们用一个数字编码器来扩充基线模型,并微调我们数据集上产生的模型。 继续使用数字编码器进行培训会进一步提高参数的响应性,降低被搁置互动类型上的所有三个出错,这表明加强数字调制是使世界模拟器能够在特定物理条件下准确再现动态的有希望的方向. 总之,我们的基准、数据集和模型探索为研究超出一般物理可行性的世界模拟提供了基础。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Speed decides the outcome in simulation but often not in generation. In simulation only the faster book tips the can onto the shelf, but PhysAlign, even told so, leaves it on the table at both speeds. ✓ / ✗ : match/contradict the simulation.
blocks.zh: 图2 速度在模拟中决定结果,但往往不是在生成中. 在模拟中,只有更快的书将罐子插入到书架上,但是PhysAlign,甚至告诉了这一点,让它以两种速度放在桌子上. & / :匹配/质疑模拟.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • A benchmark for physical parameter responsiveness. We introduce a benchmark spanning 20 scenarios, together with event-level and parameter-level metrics that assess whether generated dynamics correctly reflect specified physical parameters. Our evaluation identifies substantial limitations in current state-of-the-art models. • A dataset with controlled physical parameters. We develop a configurable simulation pipeline and construct a dataset of 72,000 videos covering diverse parameter combinations and their resulting dynamics. We show that fine-tuning on this dataset improves physical parameter responsiveness. • An investigation of numerical conditioning. We augment a baseline model with a numerical encoder and show that continued training with it further improves parameter responsiveness on held-out interaction types, highlighting numerical conditioning as a promising direction for parameter-controlled world simulation.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面: • 物理参数响应的基准。 我们采用了一个涵盖20个假设情况的基准,以及事件级别和参数级别衡量标准,用以评估产生的动态是否正确反映特定的物理参数。 我们的评价查明了目前最新模式的重大局限性。 带有可控物理参数的数据集. 我们开发了一个可配置的模拟管道,并构建了一个包含72 000个视频的数据集,涵盖不同的参数组合及其产生的动态。 我们显示,对这一数据集进行微调可提高物理参数的响应性。 调查数字条件 我们用一个数字编码器来增加一个基线模型,并表明继续培训这个模型将进一步提高对所持有的相互作用类型的参数反应能力,强调数字条件是参数控制的世界模拟的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: A benchmark for physical parameter responsiveness. We introduce a benchmark spanning 20 scenarios, together with event-level and parameter-level metrics that assess whether generated dynamics correctly reflect specified physical parameters. Our evaluation identifies substantial limitations in current state-of-the-art models.
blocks.zh: 物理参数响应性的基准. 我们采用了一个涵盖20个假设情况的基准,以及事件级别和参数级别衡量标准,用以评估产生的动态是否正确反映特定的物理参数。 我们的评价查明了目前最新模式的重大局限性。

blocks.en: A dataset with controlled physical parameters. We develop a configurable simulation pipeline and construct a dataset of 72,000 videos covering diverse parameter combinations and their resulting dynamics. We show that fine-tuning on this dataset improves physical parameter responsiveness.
blocks.zh: 带有可控物理参数的数据集. 我们开发了一个可配置的模拟管道,并构建了一个包含72 000个视频的数据集,涵盖不同的参数组合及其产生的动态。 我们显示这个数据集的微调可以提高物理参数的响应性.

blocks.en: An investigation of numerical conditioning. We augment a baseline model with a numerical encoder and show that continued training with it further improves parameter responsiveness on held-out interaction types, highlighting numerical conditioning as a promising direction for parameter-controlled world simulation.
blocks.zh: 调查数字条件 我们用一个数字编码器来增加一个基线模型,并表明继续培训这个模型将进一步提高对所持有的相互作用类型的参数反应能力,强调数字条件是参数控制的世界模拟的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Constructing PhysResponse. Scenes are assembled from household assets and four backgrounds, edited one physical condition at a time, simulated in Genesis and Isaac and rendered from three views; panel 2 brackets two reference transitions, in the initial speed of T17 and the channel width of T05. Depth and masks are derived from RGB.
blocks.zh: 图3:构建物理响应. 场景由家庭资产和四个背景组装而成,一次编辑出一个物理条件,由创世纪和以撒模拟出并取自三个观点; 第2面板括号中有两个参考过渡,初始速度为T17,信道宽度为T05. 深度和口罩来源于RGB.

blocks.en: Video generators use simulated dynamics and explicit controls to specify physical behavior [ 26 , 46 , 14 , 58 , 12 ] , while physics-oriented post-training improves motion realism [ 20 , 19 , 61 ] . PhyCo [ 31 ] introduces controllable physical priors; PhyParam [ 25 ] pairs simulated rigid-body videos with object-level parameters and evaluates physical-law consistency. PhysResponse focuses on multi-object interactions, linking controlled physical inputs to both the motion they produce and the events they trigger.
blocks.zh: 视频生成器使用模拟动态和明确的控制来指定物理行为[26,46,14,58,12],而以物理为导向的后训练则能提高运动现实主义[20,19,61]. PhyCo [31]引入了可控物理前传;PhyParam [25]对相模拟有物体级参数的刚体视频并评价物理法一致性. PhysResponse专注于多对象相互作用,将受控的物理输入与它们产生的运动和触发的事件都联系起来.

blocks.en: Benchmarks assess physical plausibility through human or vision-language judgments [ 1 , 2 , 27 , 21 , 63 , 15 , 16 , 56 ] , or measure motion against real and simulated references [ 30 , 17 , 49 , 42 ] . PhysInOne [ 64 ] measures spectral motion agreement, WorldBench [ 45 ] examines numerical physical properties, and Principia [ 40 ] tests inter-object relations. Fall-time analyses [ 41 ] and PhysWeep [ 18 ] recover physical quantities from generated motion, with PhysWeep studying sweeps across five single-object systems. Counterfactual benchmarks test responses to changed conditions in reasoning [ 3 , 57 , 10 , 4 , 43 ] and generation [ 8 , 5 , 22 ] : PhysicsLENS [ 28 ] varies stated physical properties, and GeoFlip [ 24 ] tests outcome flips under geometric interventions. PhysResponse brings parameter recovery and transition-based event evaluation together in multi-object scenes, testing whether generated motion matches the specified conditions and produces the corresponding interactions.
blocks.zh: 基准通过人文或视觉语言判断[1、2、27、21、63、15、16、56],或对照真实和模拟的参考文献衡量运动的物理可信性[30、17、49、42]。 PhysIn One [64] 度量光谱运动协议,World Bench [45] 考察数值物理性质,而Principia [40] 测试对象间关系. 倒计时分析 [41] 和 PhysWeep [18] 从产生的运动中回收物理量,由 PhysWeep 研究横扫五个单对象系统. 反事实基准测试对推理[3,57,10,4,43]和生成[8,5,22]中条件变化的反应:物理LENS[28]不同所说明的物理性质,GeoFlip[24]在几何干涉下测试结果翻转. PhysResponse在多对象场景中将参数恢复和以过渡为基础的事件评价结合在一起,测试所生成的运动是否与指定条件相匹配并产生相应的相互作用.

blocks.en: Physical inference matches simulations to observed motion [ 51 , 59 ] , learns representations from video [ 52 ] , or uses differentiable simulation [ 23 ] ; related work probes dynamic properties in video foundation models [ 60 ] . We use simulation matching to recover effective gravity, friction and initial speed, conditioning on known geometry, camera, initial state and non-target settings. This provides a quantitative account of the dynamics behind generated interactions.
blocks.zh: 物理推论将模拟匹配到被观测到的运动[51,59],从视频中学习表现[52],或者使用可分化的模拟[23];相相关的工作探测了视频基础模型中的动态属性[60]. 我们利用模拟比对来恢复有效的重力,摩擦和初始速度,在已知的几何,相机,初始状态和非目标设置上进行调节. 这从数量上说明了产生互动背后的动态。

blocks.en: 3 The PhysResponse Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 物理响应数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Interaction Coverage and Physical Conditions
blocks.zh: 3.1 互动覆盖面和物质条件

blocks.en: PhysResponse links editable physical conditions to multi-object motion and interaction outcomes (Fig. 4 ; Table 1 ). Its 20 everyday interaction types (scenarios T01–T20) span four mechanisms: inclined-surface motion, collision-mediated transfer, changes of support, and multistage cascades. Gravity affects acceleration and fall timing; friction affects sliding and motion transfer through contact; initial speed determines whether and when objects reach one another.
blocks.zh: PhysResponse将可编辑的物理条件与多对象运动和交互结果相链接(图4;表1). 其20种日常互动类型(情景T01-T20)包括四种机制:倾角-表面运动、由碰撞调解的转移、支持的变化和多阶段级联。 引力会影响加速度和倒计时;摩擦会影响滑动和通过接触运动转移;初始速度会决定物体是否和何时相接.

blocks.en: The dataset contains 72,000 videos from 24,000 simulation runs, each rendered from three synchronized viewpoints. Each type contributes 3,600 videos: 2,640 from Genesis [ 13 ] and 960 from Isaac Sim [ 33 ] . All views of a run share the same data split.
blocks.zh: 数据集包含24 000个模拟运行的72 000个视频,每个视频来自三个同步角度。 每个类型都贡献了3,600个视频:2,640个出自"创世纪"[13],960个出自"以撒·西姆"[33]. 一个运行的所有视图共享相同的数据分割.

blocks.en: 3.2 Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 建筑业

blocks.en: Scenes specify object configurations, initial states, contact settings, and prescribed controls (Fig. 3 ). We edit gravity across five levels from 1.62 to 24 m/s 2 , with scene-specific friction and initial-speed settings. Four backgrounds and three viewpoints provide appearance variation. Available simulation states and contact records support parameter measurements and reference event outcomes.
blocks.zh: Scees指定对象配置,初始状态,联系人设置,以及指定的控制(图3.). 我们在1.62至24 m/s 2的5个级别上编辑引力,并有场景特定的摩擦和初始速度设置. 四个背景和三个观点提供了外观变化。 现有的模拟状态和联系记录支持参数测量和参考事件结果.

blocks.en: Controlled interventions vary one target condition while fixing non-target conditions. Dependent quantities change accordingly, such as angular speed when editing a rolling object’s linear speed. Reference simulations locate and refine parameter intervals across which event outcomes flip. Configurations resampled across multiple inputs populate the training pool, providing examples of how physical conditions shape motion and interactions.
blocks.zh: 受控制的干预措施在确定非目标条件时,会改变一个目标条件。 相依数量相应改变,例如编辑滚动物体的线性速度时的角快. 参考模拟定位并完善了参数间隔,然后将事件结果翻转。 在多个投入中重新被复制的配置为培训池所覆盖,提供了物理条件如何形成运动和互动的实例。

blocks.en: Core100 selects five cases per interaction type for evaluation. Figure 3 illustrates training prompts; evaluation uses four English formats: Short states the interaction and physical values; Standard embeds these values in a natural description; Detailed adds the initial spatial arrangement; and Concat appends values to a fixed template. Some prompts also state expected event outcomes. These resources support both learning physical responses and evaluating their motion-level parameters and event-level consequences.
blocks.zh: Core100每个互动类型选择5个案例进行评价. 图3显示了培训提示;评价采用四种英文格式: short 说明相互作用和物理值; 标准将这些值嵌入到自然描述中; 细节添加了初始空间安排; 而 Concat 附加到固定模板中. 一些提示还说明了预期的活动结果。 这些资源既支持学习物理反应,也支持评价其运动级参数和事件级后果.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6个实验

blocks.en: 6.1 Setup and metric validation
blocks.zh: 6.1 设置和度量验证

blocks.en: We evaluate ten models [ 55 , 32 , 34 , 39 , 29 , 53 , 61 , 11 , 38 ] on Core100 using four prompt formats and seed 0: 4,000 generated videos. Videos retain native timing. Parameter and motion scores pool formats; event tables report Standard and Detailed.
blocks.zh: 我们使用四种即时格式和0号种子评价Core100上的10个模型[55,32,34,39,29,53,61,11,38]:4000出品的视频. 视频保留本地时间. 参数和运动分数池格式;事件表报告标准与细节。

blocks.en: Alongside parameter and event metrics (Secs. 4.2 – 5.3 ), we report video-averaged PSNR, SSIM [ 50 ] , displacement L2 error relative to image height, and moving-region S-IoU [ 30 ] . Meas. is the proportion of videos judged measurable by blind human annotators.
blocks.zh: 除了参数和事件衡量标准(Sec.4.2 – 5.3)之外,我们报告视频平均PSNR、SSIM [50]、相对于图像高度的迁移 L2 错误,以及移动区域S-IoU [30]。 Meas.是被盲目的人类注释者判断的视频比例.

blocks.en: Processing GT videos with the same pipeline yields gravity, friction and speed errors of 3.6%, 1.4% and 1.1%; displacement is 0.91 and causal-order accuracy 99%. These establish a reference for interpreting generated-video errors. Fitting baselines and perturbation controls appear in Supp. Tables 31–33.
blocks.zh: 处理同一管线的GT视频产生3.6%、1.4%和1.1%的重力、摩擦和速度差;迁移为0.91,因果顺序精确度为99%。 这为解释生成的视频错误提供了参考。 组合基线和扰动控制载于补编。

blocks.en: Against blind human annotations of all 4,000 videos, automatic measurability agreement is 74%. Of 6,070 binary human-labeled events in human-measurable videos, 68% receive automatic binary judgments, with 79% agreement (Supp. Table 26).

blocks.en: 6.2 Results Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.2 成果分析

blocks.en: 6.2.1 Parameter-level evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.2.1 参数级评价

blocks.en: Even the lowest parameter errors exceed GT errors by over an order of magnitude (Table 4 ), consistently across retained shares (Supp. Fig. 13). Recovered values also barely follow the prompts: within scenes, the rank correlation between prompted and recovered gravity, net of a grid-only null, is − 0.13 -0.13 to + 0.16 +0.16 across the ten models, against + 0.77 +0.77 for GT (Supp. G). MiniMax-H3 leads on gravity and friction, yet under a Moon-gravity prompt its motion matches g ^ = 11.8 \widehat{g}=11.8 m/s 2 (Fig. 6 ). PhysRVG and VideoGPA post-train Wan2.2-TI2V-5B and PhysAlign post-trains Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, yet their gains over these bases are uneven: PhysRVG lowers friction error but raises gravity and speed errors, VideoGPA lowers gravity and friction errors but raises speed error, and PhysAlign mainly lowers speed error.
blocks.zh: 即使是最低参数出错也超过GT出错的大小(表4),在所保留的股份之间始终如一(Supp. fig.13)。 被恢复的值也几乎不跟随提示:在场景中,被激发重力和被恢复重力之间的分级关联,被网格纯空格所抵消,在十种模型中为−0.13-0.13至+0.16+0.16,而GT(Supp.G)为+0.77+0.77. MiniMax-H3引出重力和摩擦力,然而在月球重力下激发出它的运动相匹配g^=11.8\glashat{g}=11.8 m/s2(图6). PhysRVG和VideoGPA 列车后Wan2.2-TI2V-5B和PhysAlign 后列车后Wan2.2-I2V-A14B,然而它们在这些基数上的得分并不均衡: PhysRVG会降低摩擦出错但会提高重力和速度出错,VideoGPA会降低重力和摩擦出错但会提高速度出错,PhysAlign主要会降低速度出错.

blocks.en: Visual similarity can reward weak motion: repeating the condition frame beats every model in PSNR, SSIM and L2 error. Among models, PhysRVG leads in PSNR and L2 error yet barely moves, and has the largest gravity error. Causal order is also poorly preserved: nine models score 1–28% and MiniMax-H3 54%, versus 99% for GT.
blocks.zh: 视觉相似性可以奖励弱运动:重复条件框会比PSNR,SSIM和L2错误中的每个模型都多出. 在模型中,PhysRVG在PSNR和L2出错中领先,但几乎没有移动,并有最大的重力出错. 原因顺序也保存不佳:9个型号得分1-28%和MiniMax-H354%,而GT为99%.

blocks.en: 6.2.2 Event-level evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.2.2 事件评价

blocks.en: Near/Far accuracy varies with model and prompt (Table 4 ). The 10%, 15% and 20% cutoff analysis reveals different distance responses: tightening the cutoff lowers NearAcc for Wan2.2-TI2V-5B Detailed but raises it for Cosmos3-Nano Detailed (Supp. Table 14).
blocks.zh: 近/远准确度因模型和即时而异(表4)。 10%、15%和20%的断接分析显示不同距离反应:收紧断接下限 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B的近Acc 详细但为Cosmos3-Nano Proflemed(补编第14表)而提高。

blocks.en: Success on individual conditions does not ensure correct cross-boundary responses. Despite the highest NearAcc, 67.0% and 69.6%, MiniMax-H3 attains PairAcc of only 23.1% and 18.7%. Wan2.2-I2V-A14B instead leads in PairAcc at 30.7% and 42.1%, and in VPSR at 22.9% and 34.6%. Even the strongest model scores below 50% PairAcc, while PhysRVG scores 0% under both prompt formats.
blocks.zh: 个别条件的成功不能确保正确的跨界反应。 尽管NearAcc最高,分别为67.0%和69.6%,但MiniMax-H3只获得23.1%和18.7%的PairAcc。 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B则以30.7%和42.1%领先PairAcc,以22.9%和34.6%领先VPSR。 甚至最强的模型得分也低于50%的PairAcc,而PhysRVG在两种即时格式下得分为0%.

blocks.en: Despite outcome descriptions in Standard and Detailed prompts, paired success remains limited. Under Concat prompts without descriptions of the registered outcomes, PairAcc ranges from 0 to 12.0% across the ten models on the same 51 pairs, highlighting sensitivity to prompt formulation (Supp. I).
blocks.zh: 尽管《标准》和《详细提示》对结果作了说明,但成对的成功仍然有限。 在Concat的提示下,没有说明注册结果,PairAcc在同51对的10个模型中的比例从0到12.0%不等,突出了对即时制剂的敏感性(Supp.I)。

blocks.en: 6.2.3 Complementary physical diagnoses
blocks.zh: 6.2.3 补充物理诊断

blocks.en: Joint parameter and event evaluation reveals complementary failure modes (Supp. Table 39). Among 2,385 gravity records evaluated at both levels, 48 have small parameter errors but incorrect event outcomes, while 929 have large parameter errors yet correct outcomes. Both patterns also occur for friction and initial speed. In Fig. 4 , Cosmos-Predict2 reproduces contact despite wrong speed, while Cosmos3-Nano recovers gravity but misses the domino chain.
blocks.zh: 联合参数和事件评价显示互为补充的失败模式(附表39)。 在两个级别评价的2,385个重力记录中,48个有小参数错误但事件结果不正确,而929个有大参数错误但结果正确. 两种模式也都发生在摩擦和初始速度上. 入法义. 4,Cosmos-Predict2尽管速度错误但还是复制了接触,而Cosmos3-Nano恢复了重力,但错过了多米诺链.

blocks.en: 6.3 Fine-tuning on PhysResponse
blocks.zh: 6.3 微调物理反应

blocks.en: We fine-tune Wan2.2-TI2V-5B on 16 types, excluding benchmark cases and source-sharing videos, and evaluate 80 ID cases and 20 cases from four held-out types. PR-S/PR-D continue training Standard/Detailed text-only LoRA versions with a numerical encoder that adds sinusoidal embeddings of prompted values to their text tokens (Fig. 7 , Supp. E).
blocks.zh: 我们微调了Wan2.2-TI2V-5B的16个类型,不包括基准案例和源共享视频,从被搁置的4个类型评价了80个身份识别案例和20个案例. PR-S/PR-D继续培训标准/详细文本仅限文本的LORA版本,并配有数字编码器,在其文本符号上添加被激发值的鼻音嵌入(图7,Supp.E)。

blocks.en: Both variants lower all three parameter errors and improve motion agreement (Table 5 ). Held-out gravity error falls from 140.3% to 39.8–68.6%, and speed error from 93.1% to 13.0–16.4% (Supp. Table 36). Relative to their text-only versions, PR-S/PR-D further lower gravity error on the 100 cases, from 71.0%/85.3% to 69.1%, and all three held-out errors (Supp. Tables 34 and 36). PR-S improves all ten event metrics; PR-D lowers three, including Detailed PairAcc (Table 6 ). Parameter gains need not improve events.
blocks.zh: 这两个变体都降低了所有三个参数错误,并改进了运动协议(表5. 拖出重力误差从140.3%降至39.8-68.6%,速度误差从93.1%降至13.0-16.4%(补编,表36)。 相对于其仅使用文字的版本,PR-S/PR-D进一步降低了100个案例的重力误差,从71.0%/85.3%降至69.1%,并降低了所有三个被搁置的错误(Supp.表34和36)。 PR-S改进了所有10个事件度量标准;PR-D降低3个,包括详细PairAcc(表6.). 参数收益无需改进。

blocks.en: On real WorldBench videos [ 45 ] , both variants also lower gravity and ramp-friction errors (Supp. Table 37). On 100 PhysInOne training-split scenes [ 64 ] , they outperform the base model and PhysInOne LoRA/SFT in PMF, PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS; SFT retains the best FVD (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 在真实的World Bench视频上[45],两种变体也都降低了重力和坡道-防滑错误(Supp.表37). 在100个PhysIn One训练-相接场景[64]上,他们表现优于基础模型和PMF,PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS中的PhysIn One LoRA/SFT;SFT保留了最好的FVD(表7).

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Effective parameters depend on context c c , so compensating quantities such as μ ​ g \mu g need conditional estimates (Eq. 2 ). Real-video transfer is tested only on WorldBench, and held-out types add no new objects or parameter ranges. Event scores rest on few scene clusters and partly on visual proxies. Encoder gains are not isolated from continued training, and benefits for embodied policies remain untested.
blocks.zh: 有效参数取决于上下文 c c ,所以补偿量如μ克\mu克需要有条件的估计(Eq. 2 .). real-video transfer只在World Bench上进行测试,被搁置类型不会添加新的对象或参数范围. 事件得分则停留在少数场景集群上,部分则停留在视觉代词上. 编码器的收益与继续培训并不相隔绝,对体现的政策的好处仍未检验。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We present PhysResponse, a controlled multi-object video dataset and benchmark for evaluating physical response through parameter recovery and critical-transition events. Tests on ten models show that correct events can coexist with incorrect dynamics, while visual metrics often miss these failures. Fine-tuning reduces parameter errors on held-out interactions and transfers to external benchmarks. For video models to serve as world simulators, they must capture how changes in physical conditions alter future motion and interactions. PhysResponse provides training data and evaluation tools for this capability, a foundation for predicting action consequences in embodied planning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出物理反应,这是一个受控制的多对象视频数据集,也是通过参数恢复和关键过渡事件评价物理反应的基准。 对十种模型的测试表明,正确的事件可以与不正确的动态并存,而视觉度量常错过这些故障. 精细调整可以减少搁置互动的参数错误并转移至外部基准. 视频模型要充当世界模拟器,就必须抓住物理条件的变化如何改变未来的运动和互动. 物理对策为这一能力提供培训数据和评价工具,这是在综合规划中预测行动后果的基础。
